newsitem.title: SPAIN: Three Spanish priests killed in Zaire war zone.
newsitem.headline: Three Spanish priests killed in Zaire war zone.

text.p: Three Spanish priests were killed on Thursday night in the war zone near the eastern Zairean city of Bukavu, a spokesman for the Spanish Foreign Ministry said on Friday.
"It seems the news is true," the spokesman told Reuters. "It wasn't an accident, they were assassinated."
The priests were Julio Rodriguez Jorge, 40, Fernando Mayor Garcia, 44, and Miguel Angel Isla Lucio, aged 53. No further details were available on their deaths.
Two European priests, including a Spaniard, were held by Tutsi rebels late last month in a raid on their mission in Bukavu, but they were not hurt.
A number of Spanish priests, nuns, missionaries and aid workers remain in war-torn Zaire, unable or unwilling to leave the country.
